name: Enchanted Water raises Touch of Moonlight's healing by 10% and cuts pushback by 35% (#1394)
contract: Enchanted Water rank 1 704755 (SpellFamilyName 32) reads "Increases the healing of Touch of Moonlight by $s1% and reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by $s2%". Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, EffectBasePoints 9 with DieSides 1 resolving to 10, and EffectSpellClassMask word0 0x40000, which selects Touch of Moonlight 574328 (SpellFamilyFlags word0 0x40000). Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone ends with ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, heal), and for a SPELLMOD_DAMAGE percent modifier Player::ApplySpellMod multiplies by 1 + 10/100. The metric spell_healing_done calls SpellHealingBonusDone with a fixed base of 1000 and no bonus healing, so the talented fixture must read 1100 (ratio window 1.09..1.11 covers float truncation) against 1000. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK (149) with EffectBasePoints 34 resolving to 35; Spell::Delayed and Spell::DelayedChannel read GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK) as the percentage, so the applied aura's effect amount 35 is the value they consume. The pushback path itself is not driven (that needs a hostile hit on a casting player); the amount assertion reads the aura effect that the stock code sums. Rank 2 707893 (10 -> 20 and 35 -> 70) is a separate spell and is not in this issue. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Touch of Moonlight healing without the talent
Touch of Moonlight heals 10% more with the talent
The pushback reduction effect resolves to 35
